votre_naissance_correspond_a_un_instant_: Your birth corresponds to a moment that will never occur exactly the same way again. At that precise moment, the planets, angles, and houses formed a unique configuration: your natal chart. This symbolic imprint reveals the strengths, needs, reflexes, and possibilities that make up your inner landscape.
ce_rapport_signature_represente_le_nivea: This Signature report represents the most comprehensive level of analysis offered by Luna Astralis. It does not limit itself to interpreting each element separately: it reveals the interactions between your planets, your houses, your aspects, and the major dynamics that structure your natal chart.
chaque_element_apporte_une_information_d: Each element provides different information. The planet represents an inner function. The sign describes how this energy seeks to express itself. The house indicates the area of life in which it operates. The aspects show the agreements, tensions, and interactions that give your chart its particular depth.
vous_decouvrirez_ainsi_non_seulement_cer: You will thus discover not only certain natural qualities but also contradictions, needs that can sometimes be difficult to reconcile, and resources that can develop over time. These nuances are not flaws: they contribute to the richness of your personality.
l_astrologie_ne_determine_pas_vos_decisi: Astrology does not determine your decisions and does not describe an immutable destiny. It offers a symbolic language that can help you better recognize your reactions, motivations, areas of sensitivity, and the choices that allow you to move forward with greater awareness.
certaines_pages_vous_sembleront_immediat: Some pages may feel immediately familiar to you. Others will make sense gradually. Proceed at your own pace and return to the passages that resonate with you: your natal chart is not a fixed definition, but a living map of your possibilities.
votre_theme_natal_est_une_uvre_vivante_p: Your natal chart is a living work. The more you understand its deep connections, the more you discover the resources that allow you to fully evolve.
vos_trois_grands_piliers_le_soleil_la_lu: Your three main pillars: the Sun, the Moon, and the Ascendant.
l_expression_de_vos_dix_principales_plan: The expression of your ten main planets in their signs.
les_domaines_de_vie_actives_par_vos_mais: The areas of life activated by your astrological houses.
les_aspects_majeurs_et_les_dialogues_ent: The major aspects and dialogues between your different energies.
la_repartition_de_vos_elements_feu_terre: The distribution of your elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
vos_modalites_dominantes_et_votre_manier: Your dominant modalities and your natural way of acting.
vos_forces_vos_defis_et_les_ressources_a: Your strengths, challenges, and resources to develop.
vos_dynamiques_relationnelles_profession: Your relational dynamics, professional life, and your main axes of evolution.
